scripts.cap:sync: vite build && npx cap sync android
scripts.cap:android: vite build && npx cap sync && CAPACITOR_ANDROID_STUDIO_PATH=/snap/bin/android-studio npx cap open android
scripts.cap:ios: vite build && npx cap sync && npx cap open ios
scripts.deploy:debug: vite build && npx cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew installDebug
scripts.deploy:bundle: vite build && npx cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew bundleRelease
